grammar.pattern: 越来越 + 形容词 / 心理动词
grammar.explanation: 越来越清楚 compares later states with earlier ones. It does not say two people have equal ability or that a qualification has been achieved. 越练习，越清楚 links two changing quantities. Read the actual record before judging how much progress was made; increasingly is not a numerical score.

examples.zh: 第一次不清楚，现在越来越清楚。
examples.py: dì yī cì bù qīng chǔ , xiàn zài yuè lái yuè qīng chǔ .
examples.en: It was unclear the first time; now it is becoming clearer.

examples.py: yuè liàn xí , yuè yǒu xìn xīn .
examples.en: The more you practise, the more confident you become.

examples.zh: 越来越喜欢，不等于已经看完。
examples.py: yuè lái yuè xǐ huān , bù děng yú yǐ jīng kàn wán .
examples.en: Liking it more and more does not mean having finished it.

commonMistakes.right: 我现在比昨天清楚，也越来越有信心。
commonMistakes.why: Use 比 for an explicit comparison and 越来越 for a developing trend.

grammar.pattern: 不但…而且… / 还 / 更
grammar.purpose: Add information and identify a stronger point
grammar.explanation: 不但能读，而且能说 adds a second ability. 更清楚 adds a stronger comparison in context; 还 can add another point. With one shared subject, 我不但…而且… is natural. When subjects differ, 不但我…，而且她… places the connective before the first subject. Neither construction implies perfection.

examples.py: tā bù dàn néng dú , ér qiě néng shuō .
examples.en: She can not only read but also speak.

examples.zh: 不但我参加，而且她也参加。
examples.py: bù dàn wǒ cān jiā , ér qiě tā yě cān jiā .
examples.en: Not only I but she too takes part.

examples.py: xiàn zài hái gèng yǒu xìn xīn .
examples.en: Now there is also more confidence.

commonMistakes.wrong: 不但我能读，所以能说。这里要补充另一点。
commonMistakes.why: An additive relation is not the same as a causal one.

reading.title: A small progress record
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 上周我只画了一张桌子，这周想把桌子旁边的猫也画进去。可是猫一直走来走去，我刚画出头，它已经坐到另一边了。
lines.py: shàng zhōu wǒ zhǐ huà le yī zhāng zhuō zi , zhè zhōu xiǎng bǎ zhuō zi páng biān de māo yě huà jìn qù . kě shì māo yì zhí zǒu lái zǒu qù , wǒ gāng huà chū tóu , tā yǐ jīng zuò dào lìng yī biān le .
lines.en: Last week I drew only a table. This week I wanted to add the cat beside it, but the cat kept moving. By the time I'd drawn its head, it was on the other side.

lines.zh: 陈宇来看我的画，说桌子越来越像了。我说自己以前想成为画家，现在连一只猫都画不完。他笑了，让我先等猫睡着。
lines.py: chén yǔ lái kàn wǒ de huà , shuō zhuō zi yuè lái yuè xiàng le . wǒ shuō zì jǐ yǐ qián xiǎng chéng wéi huà jiā , xiàn zài lián yī zhǐ māo dōu huà bù wán . tā xiào le , ràng wǒ xiān děng māo shuì zháo .
lines.en: Chen Yu said the table was looking more convincing. I'd once dreamed of becoming a painter, I said, yet couldn't finish one cat. He laughed and suggested waiting until it slept.

lines.zh: 我想起网上看到的展览，早就想去，可周末一直没空。陈宇在网站上查了时间，发现周四晚上也开门。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng qǐ wǎng shàng kàn dào de zhǎn lǎn , zǎo jiù xiǎng qù , kě zhōu mò yì zhí méi kōng . chén yǔ zài wǎng zhàn shàng chá le shí jiān , fā xiàn zhōu sì wǎn shang yě kāi mén .
lines.en: I remembered an exhibition I'd seen online. I'd wanted to go for a while but had no free weekends. Chen Yu checked the website and found it open on Thursday evenings.

lines.zh: 周四我们下班后一起去。展览里有画家的作品，也有她年轻时用过的本子，里面画了许多很小的桌子和椅子。
lines.py: zhōu sì wǒ men xià bān hòu yì qǐ qù . zhǎn lǎn lǐ yǒu huà jiā de zuò pǐn , yě yǒu tā nián qīng shí yòng guò de běn zi , lǐ miàn huà le xǔ duō hěn xiǎo de zhuō zi hé yǐ zi .
lines.en: We went after work on Thursday. The exhibition showed the painter's works and notebooks she'd used when younger, full of tiny tables and chairs.

lines.zh: 画家出来和大家说话，我问她是不是一开始就画得好。她拿出一张旧画，说这张桌子的一条腿比别的长，自己现在还留着。
lines.py: huà jiā chū lái hé dà jiā shuō huà , wǒ wèn tā shì bú shì yī kāi shǐ jiù huà de hǎo . tā ná chū yī zhāng jiù huà , shuō zhè zhāng zhuō zi de yī tiáo tuǐ bǐ bié de zhǎng , zì jǐ xiàn zài hái liú zhe .
lines.en: When the painter spoke with us I asked whether she'd been good from the start. She showed an old drawing of a table with one leg longer than the others; she'd still kept it.

lines.zh: 回家以后，我把没画完的猫放在桌上，今后还想继续画。陈宇给我发了张照片，这回猫睡着了，我终于不用追着它看。
lines.py: huí jiā yǐ hòu , wǒ bǎ méi huà wán de māo fàng zài zhuō shàng , jīn hòu hái xiǎng jì xù huà . chén yǔ gěi wǒ fā le zhāng zhào piān , zhè huí māo shuì zháo le , wǒ zhōng yú bù yòng zhuī zhe tā kàn .
lines.en: Back home I put the unfinished cat drawing on the table and wanted to keep going. Chen Yu sent a photo of the cat asleep. I finally didn't have to chase it to look at it.

extraReadings.purpose: Understand each word in a different situation.

lines.zh: 这条路越走越窄。
lines.py: zhè tiáo lù yuè zǒu yuè zhǎi .
lines.en: The path gets narrower the farther we go.

lines.zh: 越练习，我越有信心。
lines.py: yuè liàn xí , wǒ yuè yǒu xìn xīn .
lines.en: The more I practise, the more confident I become.

lines.zh: 房间里的人越来越多。
lines.py: fáng jiān lǐ de rén yuè lái yuè duō .
lines.en: More and more people are entering the room.

lines.zh: 她的画越来越好看了。
lines.py: tā de huà yuè lái yuè hǎo kàn le .
lines.en: Her drawings are getting lovelier.

lines.zh: 我们终于把这件事做成了。
lines.py: wǒ men zhōng yú bǎ zhè jiàn shì zuò chéng le .
lines.en: We finally accomplished this.

lines.zh: 这张画没画成，明天再试吧。
lines.py: zhè zhāng huà méi huà chéng , míng tiān zài shì ba .
lines.en: I didn't finish this drawing. I'll try again tomorrow.

lines.zh: 她想成为画家。
lines.py: tā xiǎng chéng wéi huà jiā .
lines.en: She wants to become a painter.

lines.zh: 多年以后，他们成为了好朋友。
lines.py: duō nián yǐ hòu , tā men chéng wéi le hǎo péng you .
lines.en: Years later they became good friends.

lines.zh: 她终于实现了开书店的理想。
lines.py: tā zhōng yú shí xiàn le kāi shū diàn de lǐ xiǎng .
lines.en: She finally fulfilled her dream of opening a bookshop.

lines.zh: 这个计划今年能实现吗？
lines.py: zhè gè jì huà jīn nián néng shí xiàn ma ?
lines.en: Can this plan be carried out this year?

lines.zh: 我早就想参加，现在才有空。
lines.py: wǒ zǎo jiù xiǎng cān jiā , xiàn zài cái yǒu kōng .
lines.en: I've wanted to join for ages and am only free now.

lines.zh: 她早就看过这部电影了。
lines.py: tā zǎo jiù kàn guò zhè bù diàn yǐng le .
lines.en: She saw this film long ago.

lines.zh: 读了三遍，我才明白。
lines.py: dú le sān biàn , wǒ cái míng bái .
lines.en: I only understood after reading it three times.

lines.zh: 他等到下午三点才走。
lines.py: tā děng dào xià wǔ sān diǎn cái zǒu .
lines.en: He didn't leave until three in the afternoon.

lines.zh: 两个人同时说，我没听清。
lines.py: liǎng gè rén tóng shí shuō , wǒ méi tīng qīng .
lines.en: I couldn't hear clearly when both spoke at once.

lines.zh: 两个活动同时开始，我只能去一个。
lines.py: liǎng gè huó dòng tóng shí kāi shǐ , wǒ zhǐ néng qù yī gè .
lines.en: The two events start at the same time; I can only attend one.

lines.zh: 今后每周我们都见一次吧。
lines.py: jīn hòu měi zhōu wǒ men dōu jiàn yī cì ba .
lines.en: Let's meet once every week from now on.

lines.zh: 她想今后多留一点时间画画。
lines.py: tā xiǎng jīn hòu duō liú yī diǎn shí jiān huà huà .
lines.en: She wants to make more time for drawing in future.

lines.zh: 我在广告里看见了这家店。
lines.py: wǒ zài guǎng gào lǐ kàn jiàn le zhè jiā diàn .
lines.en: I saw this shop in an advertisement.

lines.zh: 门口的广告写着周末有表演。
lines.py: mén kǒu de guǎng gào xiě zhe zhōu mò yǒu biǎo yǎn .
lines.en: The advertisement outside says there's a performance at the weekend.

lines.zh: 我在网站上找到了开门时间。
lines.py: wǒ zài wǎng zhàn shàng zhǎo dào le kāi mén shí jiān .
lines.en: I found the opening hours on the website.

lines.zh: 这个网站有很多画家的介绍。
lines.py: zhè gè wǎng zhàn yǒu hěn duō huà jiā de jiè shào .
lines.en: This website introduces many painters.

lines.zh: 我把照片发到网上了。
lines.py: wǒ bǎ zhào piān fā dào wǎng shàng le .
lines.en: I posted the photo online.

lines.zh: 网上也能买这本书。
lines.py: wǎng shàng yě néng mǎi zhè běn shū .
lines.en: You can buy this book online too.

lines.zh: 她最喜欢的明星今晚有表演。
lines.py: tā zuì xǐ huān de míng xīng jīn wǎn yǒu biǎo yǎn .
lines.en: Her favourite star has a performance tonight.

lines.zh: 这位明星以前住在这条街上。
lines.py: zhè wèi míng xīng yǐ qián zhù zài zhè tiáo jiē shàng .
lines.en: This star used to live on this street.

lines.zh: 这部影片我还没有看完。
lines.py: zhè bù yǐng piàn wǒ hái méi yǒu kàn wán .
lines.en: I haven't finished watching this film.

lines.zh: 影片还没开始，我们先找座位。
lines.py: yǐng piàn hái méi kāi shǐ , wǒ men xiān zhǎo zuò wèi .
lines.en: The film hasn't begun. Let's find our seats first.

lines.zh: 这本小说我看了三遍。
lines.py: zhè běn xiǎo shuō wǒ kàn le sān biàn .
lines.en: I've read this novel three times.

lines.zh: 她写的第一部小说今年出版了。
lines.py: tā xiě de dì yī bù xiǎo shuō jīn nián chū bǎn le .
lines.en: Her first novel was published this year.

lines.zh: 我画一张图，再说给你听。
lines.py: wǒ huà yī zhāng tú , zài shuō gěi nǐ tīng .
lines.en: I'll draw a diagram and then explain it.

lines.zh: 她在纸上画了一只猫。
lines.py: tā zài zhǐ shàng huà le yī zhǐ māo .
lines.en: She drew a cat on the paper.

lines.zh: 这张画儿是我画的。
lines.py: zhè zhāng huàr shì wǒ huà de .
lines.en: I made this drawing.

lines.zh: 孩子们把画儿贴在墙上。
lines.py: hái zi men bǎ huàr tiē zài qiáng shàng .
lines.en: The children put their drawings on the wall.

lines.zh: 这位画家喜欢画家乡的街道。
lines.py: zhè wèi huà jiā xǐ huān huà jiā xiāng de jiē dào .
lines.en: This painter likes depicting the streets of their hometown.

lines.zh: 我去看了一位年轻画家的作品。
lines.py: wǒ qù kàn le yī wèi nián qīng huà jiā de zuò pǐn .
lines.en: I went to see a young painter's works.

lines.zh: 这位作家写过很多小说。
lines.py: zhè wèi zuò jiā xiě guò hěn duō xiǎo shuō .
lines.en: This writer has written many novels.

lines.zh: 我想给喜欢的作家写一封信。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng gěi xǐ huān de zuò jiā xiě yī fēng xìn .
lines.en: I'd like to write a letter to a favourite writer.

lines.zh: 她从小就对科学有兴趣。
lines.py: tā cóng xiǎo jiù duì kē xué yǒu xìng qù .
lines.en: She's been interested in science since childhood.

lines.zh: 这个展览介绍了科学的发展。
lines.py: zhè gè zhǎn lǎn jiè shào le kē xué de fā zhǎn .
lines.en: This exhibition introduces the development of science.

lines.zh: 这一科的成绩还没出来。
lines.py: zhè yī kē de chéng jì hái méi chū lái .
lines.en: The result for this subject isn't out yet.

lines.zh: 他每一科都很认真地学习。
lines.py: tā měi yī kē dōu hěn rèn zhēn de xué xí .
lines.en: He studies every subject seriously.

lines.zh: 这首歌最近很流行。
lines.py: zhè shǒu gē zuì jìn hěn liú xíng .
lines.en: This song has been popular recently.

lines.zh: 那时流行穿这种外套。
lines.py: nà shí liú xíng chuān zhè zhǒng wài tào .
lines.en: This type of coat was fashionable then.

audio.zh: 网站上写周四晚上也开门。
audio.py: wǎng zhàn shàng xiě zhōu sì wǎn shang yě kāi mén .
audio.en: The website says it's open on Thursday evenings too.

tasks.statement: The exhibition also opens on Thursday evening.
tasks.why: This detail is stated in the heard line.

audio.zh: 回家以后，我把没画完的猫放在桌上，今后还想继续画。陈宇给我发了张照片，这回猫睡着了，我终于不用追着它看。
audio.py: huí jiā yǐ hòu , wǒ bǎ méi huà wán de māo fàng zài zhuō shàng , jīn hòu hái xiǎng jì xù huà . chén yǔ gěi wǒ fā le zhāng zhào piān , zhè huí māo shuì zháo le , wǒ zhōng yú bù yòng zhuī zhe tā kàn .
audio.en: Back home I put the unfinished cat drawing on the table and wanted to keep going. Chen Yu sent a photo of the cat asleep. I finally didn't have to chase it to look at it.

tasks.statement: The cat in Chen Yu’s photo keeps moving.
tasks.why: The heard line explicitly states a different result.

prompt.zh: 周末没空，展览周四晚上也开门，去吗？
prompt.py: zhōu mò méi kōng , zhǎn lǎn zhōu sì wǎn shang yě kāi mén , qù ma ?
prompt.en: Shall we go Thursday evening if weekends are busy and it opens then too?

tasks.why: This reply responds directly to the immediate question.

prompt.py: māo yì zhí dòng , wǒ zěn me huà ?
prompt.en: How can I draw the cat when it keeps moving?

notes:
AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 二44, 二63. Native check: 越来越 versus explicit 比 comparisons, paired 越 clauses, connective scope with different subjects, 才 focus, neutral 员/家 suffixes and 画儿 erhua. Drawn colours are context for 颜/色, not audited extra vocabulary. Original joke; native review remains pending. Planned retrieval 二31 / 二51 / 二34 / 二43 / 二77: 她说得很清楚。, 带书、笔什么的就行。, 我想看书，你呢？.
2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Late HSK 2 correction: acquaintances reading a newspaper and planning New Year; a half-hour visit with the right novel and a forgotten scarf; painting an uncooperative cat and visiting an exhibition; old group photos and a sister’s tea shop. Removed app-policy/identity/medical-disclaimer leakage from ordinary speech and replaced metalinguistic word examples with independent situations. All target records get two authored contexts. Preserved old unit/word/task IDs. Native flags: suffix 家, 老/小 address forms, 等 list suffix, aspiration 成为/实现, result 成, scope of 以上/以下, 得 dé and 长 zhǎng, concrete medicine nouns 药片/药水 and subject 科. 画儿 remains subject to the explicit unresolved-audio policy, never native-reviewed. Check exact question facts, inclusive age bounds and the teasing tone. Native review pending; no independent pronunciation or learner-mastery certification.
